office_does: The assessor values Ferry County property for taxation and keeps the county's ownership and parcel records.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Rachel D. Siracuse, in the office since 2000 and elected Assessor six times by her account, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Ferry County Assessor, in the office since 2000; an accredited appraiser and former Republic City Council member.
highlights: Elected Assessor six times by her account; in the office since 2000 [S1]
Elected to the Republic City Council in 2017 and 2021 [S1]
Stresses explaining property taxes and assessments to residents [S1]
